milestones.title: M0 — Foundation
milestones.description: Repository, agent instructions/skills, issue-first PR workflow, minimal loadable addon, validation and packaging; no gameplay.

milestones.title: M1 — Reference and workshop
milestones.description: Pinned reference and deterministic runner, then the pure-Lua workshop and first transition. Run early client/model smoke probes.

milestones.title: M2 — Planetary conversion
milestones.description: Material pipeline, construction, power/storage, network thinking, exhaustion and expansion gate.

milestones.title: M3 — Cosmic phase and endings
milestones.description: Dragonling/probe expansion, 16 ms combat, recovery, prestige, correspondence and terminal liquidation.

milestones.title: M4 — Forever integration and presentation
milestones.description: Logical-clock host, versioned persistence, progressive Liquid Glass UI, assets, animated goblin Director and settings.

milestones.title: M5 — Release acceptance
milestones.description: Complete traceability and current-build client/performance/save checks, release packaging and distribution.

issues.title: Project scaffold, instructions, skills, validation and packaging
issues.scope: Create the setup using Gnomesweeper, AltStable and Glass* conventions: AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md, Codex and Claude wow-addon-review skills, Claude codex-consult/client-update, TOC 16001, Compat.lua, load event and /tim commands, account-wide SavedVariables declaration, Lua 5.1 checks, deployment, .pkgmeta and packaging CI. Preserve the supplied docs and storyboards byte-for-byte. Keep the owner-created MIT license. Issue-first workflow, PRs and owner-controlled merges/reviews. No simulation/UI/model implementation in this milestone.
issues.acceptance: Offline checks and package dry run pass; local design docs and both storyboards are committed; slash commands load in-client on a recorded build. No saved progress is overwritten.

issues.title: Pin official Universal Paperclips bytes and source provenance
issues.scope: Retrieve the edition and five SHA-256 hashes in docs/plan/Time-Is-Money-Implementation-Spec.md. Verify combat.js -> globals.js -> projects.js -> main.js load order and the ?v3 script URLs. Inventory mutable state, host reads/writes, commands, projects, timers, and random call sites. Record reference reuse/license terms before vendoring or distributing translated source. Do not substitute the older jgmize mirror or silently update hashes.
issues.acceptance: Recorded source bytes match every supplied hash; retrieval is reproducible; missing/mismatching bytes or unestablished reuse terms are reported explicitly.

issues.title: Deterministic Node reference runner with browser host adapter
issues.scope: Execute the pinned scripts with the DOM/storage/canvas values they actually read; no generic no-op DOM. Capture interval/timeout registration, cancellation, due times and stable equal-time order. Drive logical time and timestamped commands; validate representative adapter paths against browser execution. Drawing may be disabled while combat state still updates.
issues.acceptance: Fixed traces reproduce initialization, same-due callbacks, cancellation, tournaments and 16 ms combat; compare state after commands and meaningful callbacks.

issues.title: Shared random stream and first-divergence comparison
issues.scope: Inject explicit recorded draws into both runners. Track ordinal and call-site labels, including name generation/combat initialization. Define emerging command/state schema, resources, flags, arrays and pending callbacks. Keep cosmetic RNG separate. Exact discrete/draw/timer agreement; narrow documented numeric exceptions only with threshold tests.
issues.acceptance: A deliberate extra draw, branch mismatch or altered callback order is detected at the first differing field/draw with source hashes and trace evidence.

issues.title: Pure-Lua workshop slice: bolts, input, prices, sales and first automation
issues.scope: First small port: manual production, wire/input purchases, price/demand/sales and first autoclipper/gizmo. Preserve source identifiers, formulas, operation order and numeric state. No WoW globals, clocks, frames or native randomness in simulation. Keep lifetime production, spendable stock and inventory separate.
issues.acceptance: JavaScript and Lua traces agree after each command/callback; exact-cost, depletion, no-op/unaﬀordable and first automation boundaries pass.

issues.title: Workshop computation, Ingenuity and resonance
issues.scope: Port processors/memory/trust, Operations and Creativity/Ingenuity, project availability and quantum/resonance computation incrementally. Audit JS truthiness, zero-based arrays, Math.round, coercion, remainder and numeric thresholds. Preserve negative Operations paths.
issues.acceptance: Differential boundary traces cover allocations/capacity, unlocks, resonance oscillation/chips and negative Operations without broad numeric epsilon.

issues.title: Cartel investments and Negotiation Simulator
issues.scope: Port investment portfolio/risk/profit behavior, all strategy unlocks and tournament processing/delayed callbacks, Yomi/Cunning and automation. Preserve RNG use, timer order and tie/array mutation behavior.
issues.acceptance: Fixed random/time/command traces cover purchases, losses, tournaments, strategy selection and automation, with exact outcomes and draw counts.

issues.title: Workshop projects, recovery and Universal Customer Agreement
issues.scope: Port phase-I projects, conditional/repeatable/optional entries, emergency replacement input and business recovery; apply source-defined first transition. Begin a generated 96-entry project traceability checklist that later phases extend.
issues.acceptance: Each implemented project's eligibility/cost/effect/reward/flags is traced; no duplicate reward; business economy ends at the reference transition.

issues.title: Early Forever smoke: runtime, icons and persistence
issues.scope: Before full UI integration, measure addon load/slash commands, actual build/interface, embedded Lua and numeric configuration. Show one established item, Forever battery 274048, a spell/profession icon and optional model. Handle nil/asynchronous item data with bounded requests. Test disposable save data across /reload and full exit/relaunch; do not design game saves in this probe.
issues.acceptance: docs/forever-api-notes.md records actual build, observations/failures and fallbacks; API presence is not claimed as runtime validation.

issues.title: Animated goblin probe using AltStable roster pet rendering
issues.scope: Owner direction: inspect AltStable Plugins/Roster/AltStableRoster.lua pet section, specifically PetFrame, ReadBox, PlacePet and MeasurePet, plus measured Pets findings in docs/forever-api-notes.md (1.60.1.70124). Use plain ModelScene/CreateActor and creature display IDs; preserve idle animation. Explicit narrow camera, bounds-based fit, six-number/two-vector box handling, bounded streaming polls and stale callback tokens. Probe goblin texture, head/dialogue-strip crop, idle motion, talk/approval expressions, particles and mouse/layer behavior. No guessed IDs.
issues.acceptance: Record display ID/provenance, tested build, textured rendering, readable crop, useful animation IDs and frame cost; choose verified 2D fallback. No simulation effect.

issues.title: Planetary material pipeline and construction
issues.scope: Port harvesting/refining/production and costs for harvesters, wire drones/converters and factories/foundries; preserve resource pools, construction/destruction and source thresholds. No WoW crafting yields or items.
issues.acceptance: Differential traces cover depletion, exact-cost builds, unaffordable requests, throughput and exhausted material.

issues.title: Power, battery storage and fully powered acceleration
issues.scope: Port power production/use, storage and fully-powered acceleration effects; source-defined throttling/full storage/shortage behavior and callbacks.
issues.acceptance: Parity at zero/near-threshold/full power and storage; no UI refresh or frame-rate effect.

issues.title: Company Network, thinking, recovery and expansion gate
issues.scope: Port network/drone allocations, thinking, gifts/breakthroughs, exhaustion and recovery/recommissioning. Finish phase-II projects and source expansion gate.
issues.acceptance: Parity for each phase-II project and repeat/recovery route; phase transition and allocation boundaries match exactly.

issues.title: Dragonling allocations, replication, surveying, hazards and drift
issues.scope: Port all probe allocations, population/counts, replication, cosmic matter/production, environmental hazards and Charter Drift. Preserve source RNG consumption and large-number semantics.
issues.acceptance: Fixed traces cover allocations, exact trust limits, no fleet, hazards/drift and cosmic progression.

issues.title: Franchise battles at the reference 16 ms logical tick
issues.scope: Port combat.js UpdateGrid, MoveShips and DoCombat, including entity movement, losses, counts, honor/Renown, engagement names and dependent projects. Disabling drawing must retain dynamics. Do not lower combat tick to UI refresh rate.
issues.acceptance: Entity/count/RNG traces match at each meaningful battle update; hidden/low refresh presentation cannot change outcomes.

issues.title: Cosmic recovery, campaign projects and correspondence
issues.scope: Port emergency probe restart/memory sacrifice, battle memorials/repeatable songs, victories, optional entries and seven correspondence projects 140-146. Follow original availability/effects.
issues.acceptance: Each phase-III project is traceable with costs, eligibility, flags, repeats and recovery; no duplicate rewards or draws.

issues.title: Both prestige choices, negative Operations and full liquidation
issues.scope: Preserve accept/reject departure, projects 200/201 prestige paths, unusual project217 negative-Operations restart and all projects210-216 terminal dismantling. Preserve special final-unit accounting and last manual production action.
issues.acceptance: Fixed traces cover both restart states and complete liquidation/terminal action, including huge totals and final few units.

issues.title: Forever host clock and command adapter
issues.scope: Attach the pure simulation to one controlled host scheduler and validated commands. Reopening must not create timers. UI updates/visibility/combat collapse cannot pause production/losses. No offline elapsed production; native timers are wakeups, not reference ordering.
issues.acceptance: Repeated open/close, hidden window, different UI refresh and host wakeup batching preserve logical outcomes and command eligibility.

issues.title: Versioned SavedVariables and continuation/migration
issues.scope: Design TimeIsMoneyDB schema for one company per WoW account; persist resources/projects/allocations/phase, scheduler progress, RNG/prestige/endings. Never frames/closures. Preserve recoverable data and refuse unknown future schemas without replacing them. Normal logout/reload contract, no crash durability promise or automatic reload.
issues.acceptance: Restored vs uninterrupted traces match, including tournament/battle/ending continuation; missing/malformed/old/future schemas tested; reload and full exit verified on recorded build.

issues.title: Progressive Liquid Glass ledger and campaign controls
issues.scope: Reuse GlassUnitFrames main material with attribution and drift check, never an arbitrary shared working-tree state. Apply brief/storyboards: workshop unfolds into research/finance, planetary pipeline and cosmic allocation/battle view; final panels disappear in liquidation order. Plain unprotected frames, reused controls, readable shortages/costs and tooltip names.
issues.acceptance: Every command routes through host adapter; no cosmetic delay/state/RNG effect; controls fit UI scales and phases, hidden-window simulation continues.

issues.title: Coin formatting and all 96 project/14 item presentation assets
issues.scope: Keep numeric funds in reference units; one unit displays as silver, with fractional copper preserved internally. Format negatives/huge values/threshold precision. Create asset catalog for all 96 projects and 14 initial identities with item/spell IDs, resolved assets, URL, tested build/status/fallback. Validate asynchronous icon requests before ownership assumptions.
issues.acceptance: Reference examples (0.25 -> 25c, 1 -> 1s, 123.45 -> 1g23s45c, 1e6 -> 10000g) display correctly; rounding cannot change affordability; all assets visually tested or have verified fallback.

issues.title: Animated goblin Director and dialogue strip
issues.scope: Integrate the goblin selected by the AltStable-based probe. One reused mouse-disabled ModelScene, idle preserved, measured talking/reaction animations and cancellation on hide/replacement/phase change. Verified 2D fallback and model toggle. Director's early friendly voice disappears after takeover; company reports and later correspondence follow brief. Cosmetic randomness isolated.
issues.acceptance: Live idle is readable at actual strip size; no clipping/input/timer interference; missing/late model and repeated hide/show degrade correctly; exact campaign visibility/dialogue beats.

issues.title: Help, settings and explicit new-game control
issues.scope: First-use/help/settings explain normal logout/reload saves and interrupted-session risk. Models toggle, UI scale and new-game reset with explicit confirmation; no new prestige shop or campaign chapter. Cosmetics never gate simulation.
issues.acceptance: Readable controls and reset protection verified; exact persistence wording from brief/spec; settings cannot affect formulas.

issues.title: Campaign parity, all-project coverage and current-build acceptance
issues.scope: Complete traceability of all 96 project definitions, all subsystems, transitions/recovery/optional/repeatable paths, prestige/endings. Recheck current client APIs/assets, hidden-window performance, migration/continuation and no duplicate timers/rewards. Disposable interrupted-session recovery check, with no promise of saving crashes.
issues.acceptance: Documented pass/fail matrix and source/runtime versions; first-divergence fixtures pass; every unresolved numeric/client exception explicit and bounded.

issues.title: First beta distribution, changelog and release packaging
issues.scope: Configure CurseForge project and tag webhook when requested; no distribution or release during initialization. Run pinned packager -d and exact zip allowlist/version substitution check. Player-facing changelog and install/help documentation.
issues.acceptance: Inspected package contains only addon runtime files/media/license; version token replaced; supported-build acceptance passed before owner tags/releases.
